crossRefs.note: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances, and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will…
Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for…
Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your…
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in…
Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
My God, turn your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name…
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

translations.web: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
translations.bsb: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies'
translations.asv: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness' sake.
